post_topic: LLM-agnostic architecture as a production requirement, not a feature

From that central box, three arrows fan out to the right pointing to three provider boxes stacked vertically: top box labeled 'OpenAI (GPT-4o)' with the OpenAI logo, middle box labeled 'Anthropic (Claude)' with the Anthropic logo, bottom box labeled 'Local / Ollama (Llama 3)' with a generic server icon. Above the central interface layer box, a separate box labeled 'HITL Gates + Evaluation' connects downward with a dashed arrow, with a small label 'Governance sits above model layer'. Below the central interface layer box, a small amber callout box reads 'Swap models via config — zero pipeline logic changes'. Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant.
